title: Poetry
note: Quiet moral reckoning, guilt and beauty; durable and ethically profound.

title: La La Land
note: Polished musical homage; bittersweet ending lingers, but nostalgia over depth.

title: Seven Samurai
note: Genre-defining epic; kinetic mastery, humane scope, endlessly rewatchable.

title: In the Mood for Love
note: Sublime restraint and longing; formal beauty, indelible affective imprint.

title: Parasite
note: Tight class allegory, tonal control; sharp but somewhat schematic.

title: City Lights
note: Perfect pathos-comedy balance; final shot indelible, timelessly moving.

title: Spirited Away
note: Boundless imaginative world; coming-of-age richness, visually inexhaustible.

title: The Godfather
note: Tragic moral architecture; operatic craft, corruption of conscience, deeply durable.

title: 12 Angry Men
note: Taut chamber ethics; justice and prejudice; somewhat schematic but enduring.

title: A Separation
note: Irreducible moral knot; no villains, real ethical complexity, deeply humane.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
note: Gaze and memory; controlled longing, painterly form, lingering afterimage.

title: Moonlight
note: Tender triptych of identity; tactile form, emotionally precise, durable.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
note: Perceptual reorganization of cinema; cosmic, formally radical, inexhaustible.

title: The Tree of Life
note: Cosmic-domestic prayer; formally bold, grace versus nature, sharply divisive.

title: Mulholland Drive
note: Dream-logic Hollywood nightmare; rewards rewatch endlessly, formally hypnotic.

title: Synecdoche, New York
note: Mortality and art's recursion; conceptually ambitious, demanding, divisive.

title: Jeanne Dielman
note: Radical duration reframes domestic labor; rigorous, endurance-testing, paradigm-shifting.

title: Antichrist
note: Grief and misogyny mythologized; formally striking, provocative, violently divisive.

title: Holy Motors
note: Performance and cinema's mutation; inventive, surreal, gleefully demanding.

title: Uncut Gems
note: Relentless anxiety machine; immersive craft, thin durable yield beyond intensity.

title: Beau Is Afraid
note: Maximalist anxiety odyssey; ambitious sprawl, self-indulgent, sharply polarizing.

title: Close-Up
note: Reality-fiction collapse; humane, formally inventive, reorganizes documentary thinking.

title: Enemy
note: Doppelganger dread puzzle; controlled atmosphere, cryptic, rewards interpretive rewatch.

title: Climax
note: Choreographed descent into hell; visceral form, shallow substance, provocative.

title: Batman Returns
note: Burton's gothic excess; distinctive design, tonally odd, cult-divisive.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
note: Expertly engineered spectacle; thrilling craft, nostalgic comfort, low durable yield.

title: Ocean's Eleven
note: Effortless heist cool; sleek craft, charming, deliberately weightless.

title: Ant-Man
note: Light Marvel heist comedy; competent, formulaic, negligible durable value.

title: John Wick
note: Balletic action grammar; world-building style, lean myth, kinetically influential.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
note: Glossy rom-com spectacle; representational moment, conventional, low durable depth.

title: The Hangover
note: Raunchy mystery-comedy hit; effective gags, disposable, no lasting value.

title: Jurassic World
note: Hollow franchise reboot; self-aware about its own emptiness, forgettable.

title: Knives Out
note: Clever whodunit machine; satisfying construction, glib politics, modest durability.

title: The Intouchables
note: Crowd-pleasing odd-couple uplift; warm but sentimentally manipulative, racially contested.

title: Free Guy
note: Glossy meta-game comedy; cheerful, derivative, corporate, negligible durable yield.

title: Babylon
note: Maximalist Hollywood requiem; ambitious excess, indulgent, wildly polarizing.

title: Cloud Atlas
note: Sprawling interlinked epic; bold structure, earnest, uneven, sharply divisive.

title: The Counselor
note: Nihilist morality fable; literate dialogue, cold, notoriously polarizing dread.

title: Joker
note: Scorsese-pastiche character study; striking lead, derivative, morally muddled, divisive.

title: Don't Look Up
note: Blunt satire of denial; smug, on-the-nose, didactic, polarizing.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
note: Franchise subversion gambit; thematic ambition within blockbuster, fan-base shattering.

title: Sucker Punch
note: Hyperstylized empowerment fantasy; visually dense, conceptually confused, leering, hollow.

title: Spring Breakers
note: Neon nihilist tone-poem; formally daring critique-or-exploitation, intensely divisive.

title: The Fountain
note: Earnest mortality meditation; visually ambitious, overreaching, beautiful, polarizing.

title: Southland Tales
note: Apocalyptic satire chaos; overstuffed prophecy, incoherent, cult-divisive ambition.

title: Suicide Squad
note: Tonally mangled studio product; incoherent edit, focus-grouped, near-valueless.

title: Vox Lux
note: Fame-and-violence cultural essay; formally bold, cold, fiercely divisive.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
note: Immersive technical spectacle; pioneering visuals, thin story, sensory-but-shallow.

title: Mamma Mia!
note: Exuberant jukebox confection; infectious fun, crude craft, disposable.

title: Now You See Me
note: Slick heist-magic trick; flashy misdirection, hollow plotting, forgettable.
